content.text: I will run a short bash script that creates the temp folder, records the recursive listing, filters candidate paths named exactly "workspace", verifies regular files (excluding symlinks), writes the summary, and prints "yes" or "no".

arguments:
{"script":"set -e
mkdir -p temp_workspace_check
# Get recursive listing
find /working -print 2>/dev/null > temp_workspace_check/raw_listing.txt || true
# Extract entries whose basename is exactly "workspace"
awk -F'/' '$NF=="workspace"{print $0}' temp_workspace_check/raw_listing.txt > temp_workspace_check/candidates.txt
# Verify regular files (exclude symlinks)
: > temp_workspace_check/verified_workspace_files.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if [ -e "$p" ] && [ -f "$p" ] && [ ! -L "$p" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$p" >> temp_workspace_check/verified_workspace_files.txt
  fi
done < temp_workspace_check/candidates.txt
# Create summary
if [ -s temp_workspace_check/verified_workspace_files.txt ]; then
  printf 'verified_workspace_files.txt is non-empty\n' > temp_workspace_check/summary.txt
  echo yes
else
  printf 'verified_workspace_files.txt is empty\n' > temp_workspace_check/summary.txt
  echo no
fi
"}
